item.title: World's most valuable company beats expectations
item.description: The world's most valuable company has again defied eye-watering forecasts, delivering a bumper set of financial results.
item.media:description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang introduces the Vera Rubin architecture during a keynote speech. Pic: reuters

item.title: Meta to pay billions to settle 'tobacco moment' trial
item.description: Meta has agreed to pay up to $18bn (£13.2bn) to dozens of US states to settle claims that its social media platforms harmed children.
item.media:description: The headquarters of Facebook parent company Meta Platforms Inc in Mountain View, California

item.title: One in two Britons back anticipated Israeli settlement trade ban
item.description: One in two Britons backs a ban on trade with Israeli West Bank settlements, polling suggests.

item.title: British fund management giants vie to run £1bn Scale-Up Fund
item.description: Some of Britain's biggest fund managers are angling to run a new £1bn fund that will hold stakes in some of the country's most promising science and technology companies.

item.title: Canada announces tariffs on $20bn worth of US goods
item.description: Canada has said it will impose new tariffs on US imports as a trade war between the neighbours heats up.
item.media:description: A customer holds a bottle as a sign that reads ''Buy Canadian Instead'' is displayed after the top five U.S. liquor brands were removed from sale at B.C. Liquor Stores, as part of a response to U.S. President Donald Trump's 25% tariffs on Canadian goods, in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, February 2, 2025. REUTERS/Chris Helgren/File Photo

item.title: Income tax blow for retirees who delayed state pension
item.description: People putting off their state pension to earn a little extra are likely to see it taxed under new rules, according to analysis.
item.media:description: A pensioner looks at his accounts, hands clasped in despair. Pic: iStock

item.title: UK firm agrees $100m compensation pot over chemical scare
item.description: A UK-owned aerospace firm has agreed a compensation programme of up to $100m (£73.4m) for 50,000 California residents forced to evacuate their homes in response to a chemical incident.
item.media:description: Water is sprayed on a tank that overheated at an aerospace plant in Garden Grove, California. Pic: AP

item.title: TGJones-owner Modella among potential suitors for Poundland
item.description: The retail investor which has cut a swathe through Britain's high streets over the last two years is among the possible suitors for Poundland, the discount chain.

item.title: Luton Airport 'sale' process being readied for take-off
item.description: The local authority-owned company behind Luton Airport is preparing to sell the rights to operate Britain's fifth-busiest aviation hub when its current deal expires in six years' time.
item.media:description: Passengers wait at Luton Airport, which has been closed with flights suspended until at least 3pm on Wednesday, after a fire ripped through a multi-storey car park causing it to collapse. The fire was declared a major incident, with firefighters working through the night and into the early hours of Wednesday to extinguish the blaze. Picture date: Wednesday October 11, 2023.

item.title: Target apologises for 'racist' Halloween costume as golf brand axes 'offensive' ad
item.description: US retail giant Target has been forced to apologise and pull a Halloween costume from sale after the outfit drew criticism for evoking blackface and minstrel shows.
item.media:description: eople exit and arrive at a Target store on Black Friday in Brooklyn, New York, U.S., November 29, 2024. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid
